caption:
@advicewitherin ✨ ah, the classic “what are your salary expectations?” aka “how much are you looking to make….????”

[Psst, comment or dm me “SALARY101” & I’ll send you my Salary Negotiation Guide for FREE!] 

👀 Companies ask this to see how little you’ll go for or if you’re out of their price range. 

👏 What they SHOULD do is list the salary range upfront so you can see whether or not their budget aligns with your expectations. 

😈 But then asking you first allows them to have more negotiation power. 

Avoid: 
❌ saying one number 
❌ telling them what you currently make 
❌ saying you “hope” or “wish” for 
❌ being unprepared 
❌ saying you’ll take whatever 

Best practices: 
✅ avoid putting out a number first 
✅ ask for their approved range or “salary band”
✅ say you’re flexible

Keep it open, polite & professional 😉 you got this! 👏 #salary #jobsearch #careeradvice

caption:
It's common to hear that high performers leave organizations due to burnout, but the truth is far more nuanced. They leave because they become fed up. High achievers don’t walk away from challenging work; they walk away from the friction caused by incompetence, chaos, and a lack of accountability. They grow weary of carrying the weight of the team's success while others coast along aimlessly.

High performers want to collaborate in an environment that values excellence, not one where standards are consistently lowered to accommodate mediocrity. They crave a clear lane and decisive leadership. When the expectations are continually renegotiated downward, it’s not the challenge that drives them away; it’s the absence of a commitment to maintaining high standards. In a world where everyone else is coasting, it’s no surprise that the motivated will choose to opt out. #Leadership #HighPerformance #StandardsMatter

caption:
I’ve seen it hundreds of times.

The employee who executes flawlessly, meets every deadline, and solves every problem – stuck in the same role for years.

Why? 

Because they’ve become irreplaceable where they are.

And there’s one reason why that kills careers faster than anything else:

You’re trapped in task mode.

Most people get good at checking boxes and following orders. They take pride in being reliable.

But here’s the brutal reality:

Being exceptional at following orders creates a prison that’s almost impossible to escape.

Your boss loves your execution. 

Why would they move you?

The path to rapid career growth isn’t doing tasks better — it’s understanding the strategy behind them.

Stop asking “what do I need to do?” and start asking “why does this matter to the business?”
#
When your boss asks for that quarterly report, don’t just deliver pristine spreadsheets.

Understand how those numbers connect to the CEO’s top priority.

Know why your department exists in the first place.

Recognize patterns nobody else sees.

The moment everything changed for me was when I stopped being a doer and became a strategic thinker.

I went from being passed over for promotions to being pulled into rooms I wasn’t supposed to be in yet.

Most people stay stuck because they’ve optimized for the wrong metric.

They think reliability equals promotion.

It doesn’t.

Every leader I know promotes people who make their life easier by solving problems they didn’t even know they had.

You have 24 hours to make a choice:

1. Continue being the best task-executor on your team and wonder why others keep moving up...

2. Or step back, look at the whole board, and start playing a completely different game.
The game that actually gets rewarded.

#career #careercheatcodes #careeradvice

Effective communication between landlords and tenants is crucial, particularly when dealing with unpaid rent. By clearly communicating the expectations and consequences regarding unpaid rent, landlords can prevent misunderstandings and potential legal disputes with tenants. caption:
One effective way to avoid paying capital gains tax when acquiring a family property is by placing it in a living trust and doing a Step up in Basis.  A living trust is a legal entity that can hold and manage property, and it provides several benefits, including the ability to transfer property to beneficiaries without going through probate court. By transferring ownership of the property to the trust, the property is no longer considered a personal asset and, therefore, is not subject to capital gains tax when it is sold. This is because the trust itself becomes the owner of the property, and any subsequent sale of the property is considered a transfer from the trust rather than an individual. Additionally, placing a property in a living trust can help to protect it from creditors and ensure that it is passed down to future generations according to the wishes of the original owner. 

Step-up in basis, or stepped-up basis, is what happens when the price of an inherited asset on the date of the decedent's death is above its original purchase price. The tax code allows for the raising of the cost basis to the higher price, minimizing the capital gains taxes owed if the asset is sold later.

caption:
When people call me stupid for buying my dream home with cash.

Yes, I know I could have invested that money. Yes, I know the money I spent on my home could be worth millions of dollars by the time I hit retirement age. Yes, I know that your primary residence is a sinking asset, one you pay to have, instead of it paying you. Yes, Yes, and Yes. I know.

Deciding to buy my dream home with cash was the hardest financial decision I ever had to make, but I still feel the same as when I wrote my first post about it. Revealing my dreams to the world.

"One day, I will have my dream house, and I will pay for it all with cash and know what true financial freedom feels like. When I walk up the stairs to my beautiful porch, I will kneel and thank God and cry happy tears with my son. It will be on that day that I will thank the heavens that I followed my heart.

When I did reveal to my son that mom accomplished her goal, all I could do was cry. If you haven't seen the reveal video, make sure to check out my home journey highlight!

I knew that I would never feel financially ready to leave my full-time job with a mortgage hanging over my head. I knew that I would not have the same options pursuing my true passions with my business. I knew I had a plan, one that looked vastly different from everyone else's. But I don't care.

Our ambitions, dreams, goals, and successes can't be defined by what everyone else thinks they should be.

I spent a year researching and finding clarity around my trade-off, understanding and honestly acknowledging both sides' consequences. My decision might have been different if I was sacrificing my retirement goals or other financial obligations, but I wasn't.

After my divorce and losing everything, I had to accomplish this on my own. It was my path to help rediscover who I am—a journey of finding my own strength.

People ask me if it upsets me how much money I actually said "no' to by not investing the money I spent on my home. My answer – no. 

The number at the end of 30 years was not more important than the one short life I live now. I will have more than enough when I need it.

I know exactly what I want to accomplish!💪

As a feeding therapist and CLC, the biggest hurdle I see parents face is the pressure of perfection. Sometimes, the "bridge" to a longer breastfeeding journey is the "and,” as in, breastfeeding AND supplementation.

If you’re navigating the “AND,” here is how to do it successfully:

So, when the wrist is flexed (bent), the tendons relax, opening the fingers. And when the wrist is extended (straightened), the tendons are pulled taut, flexing (bending) the fingers. As an OT, we use tenodesis grasp a lot. But I just recently realized how much I inadvertently use it with my baby, too.😂

If your goal is building muscle, higher calorie foods can help you get more food down easier.

Whole eggs over egg whites.

Muscle gain usually gets easier when food is more calorie dense.

Fat loss usually gets easier when food is more filling, lean, and lower calorie.

Nobody knows this about Google.

If you go to Google Search Console, connect your site to it, go to Performance, then Search Results.

Go to Add Filter, then Query.

Click Regex.

Paste this in:
^(who|what|where|when|why|how|was|did|do|is|are|aren't|won't|does|if)[" "]

Hit Apply.

Now you can see all the informational searches your site shows on Google for.

Informational searches have who, what, where, when, why, how, etc.

If you replace that with this:
^(buy|order|purchase|get|best price|cheap|discount|deal|promo|offer|sale|where to buy|how much|cost of|price of)[" "]

Now you can see the e-commerce searches your site shows in Google for.

Not having a profile picture isn’t mysterious by default.

It only works after credibility already exists.

In personal branding, your profile photo is a trust anchor.
It’s the first signal people use to decide:

- Is this person real?
- Are they established?
- Are they worth paying attention to?

When someone with clear authority, reputation, or network goes faceless, the brain reads it as:
privacy, distance, exclusivity.

But when that authority isn’t there yet, the same move backfires.

Instead of mystery, it signals:
avoidance, uncertainty, lack of substance.

This is why high-level entrepreneurs, operators, and insiders can afford anonymity —
while everyone else needs clarity before mystery.

Status online isn’t about hiding.
It’s about earning the right to be hidden.

Your content, network, and consistency create the foundation.
Only then does minimalism amplify authority.

Personal branding isn’t what you remove —

caption:
Most people think posting high-quality, polished content makes their brand look expensive. But on Instagram, it usually does the opposite.

The Problem with “Perfect”

When your pictures are too sharp, too posed, or too staged, they stop feeling personal. Psychologically, it signals that you need validation — and nothing kills status faster than looking try-hard.

Why Imperfection Wins

Blurry, raw, “in the moment” shots actually build more trust and authority. They feel authentic, like people are getting a glimpse into your real life.

And here’s the psychology: authenticity creates parasocial trust — the illusion that your audience truly knows you. 

That’s what makes entrepreneurs, creators, and online business owners magnetic.

The Status Play

Confidence isn’t showing perfection — it’s being comfortable showing imperfection.

High-status people don’t force attention; they let others feel like they’re catching them in the moment. That’s why a blurry Porsche shot can feel more expensive than a polished one.

If you’re building a personal brand: stop obsessing over perfection. Start focusing on creating authentic, high-status moments that actually connect.

Does the U.S. Government Watch Your Phone on a Visitor’s Visa? Brad Bernstein explains that when you enter the U.S. on a visitor’s visa, the government may check your phone. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officers have the authority to inspect your phone, including your messages, photos, and social media accounts, to determine whether you intend to comply with the terms of your visa. Always ensure your phone reflects your true intent to comply with the terms of your visa. with strings attached?

caption:
How to fix skinny-fat🙃

“Skinny-fat” is confusing?

Because the more weight you try and lose, the worse the problem seems to get?

That’s usually because people are trying to solve the wrong problem💡

The problem most people *think* they need to solve is having too much body fat.

They try and solve this by:
- adding endless cardio
- and restricting food more and more

But that’s only going to make the problem worse

Because “skinny-fat” doesn’t usually come from not having too much body fat, it comes from not having enough *muscle* underneath our fat to give us any shape or definition.

To fix this, you would want to:
- Focus on lifting heavy weights
- Actually limit your cardio (probably not more than 1/3 of your total exercise)
- And often times actually eat *more* food, not less

It’s also important to note that every human body is different, so the exact solution for each person will be a little bit different - but this generally a good place to start 🤘🏼
